subject: PrismHealth — custom EMR integration + premium support (exec sign-off requested)

Subject: Custom onboarding + premium support for PrismHealth — SOW and pricing

Hi Mina / Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks again for walking the PrismHealth team through Redwood last week. We ran the internal review and there is strong interest in taking Redwood as our inference provider for the new patient triage product — but we need a custom EMR connector and committed SRE support during the first 6 months.

Summary of asks from PrismHealth:
- Custom FHIR/EMR integration (HL7 + secure webhook mapping) — estimated 8 weeks of engineering work by Redwood.
- Premium Support (24x7 on-call + 1 dedicated SRE) for first 6 months, then transition to standard premium.
- 30% one-time commercial concession on year 1 committed spend to offset integration costs.
- Extended log retention for audit purposes (36 months) — requires security addendum.

Attached: SOW_PrismHealth_v3.pdf, pricing_summary_prismhealth.xlsx.

Samantha (cc procurement and integration teams) asked if Redwood can provide executive sign-off on the discount and the custom integration SLA this week — their board is deciding budget allocations on Monday. We can do a pilot start as early as Jan 10 if terms are approved.

Can you confirm next steps and whether we can get an exec approval path for the concession?

Best,
Samantha
Director of Product Partnerships
PrismHealth

Attachment stubs: SOW_PrismHealth_v3.pdf (pdf), pricing_summary_prismhealth.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-05T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Custom onboarding + premium support for PrismHealth — SOW and pricing

Marissa / Karthik,

Forwarding PrismHealth's note — they're asking for an executive decision on two non-standard concessions: 30% one-time discount on Y1 committed spend and 36-month log retention (security addendum). They also require 8 weeks of engineering for the EMR connector and a dedicated SRE for 6 months.

Why this needs escalation:
- Economic impact: at proposed pricing their committed ARR would be ~$420k/yr; a 30% concession materially reduces our margin in year 1.
- Scope: engineering and SRE time are outside our standard onboarding bundle (this is custom scope).
- Risk/compliance: extended retention touches our security posture — legal and security need to sign the addendum.

Requested approvals:
1) Executive approval for the 30% one-time concession (or direction on an alternate concession).
2) Approval to include 6 months of dedicated SRE in SOW and bill as part of the contract (we can shift some hours to milestone-based credits).
3) Sign-off from Security on 36-month retention or alternate retention language.

Attached: pricing_summary_prismhealth.xlsx, security_addendum_prism.pdf.

Proposed mitigation: if we must protect margin, propose 25% discount + milestone-based integration credits (payable on go-live and M+3). That reduces downside while keeping deal momentum.

I'll prepare a one-pager for execs if you want to tee this up. Need a decision by EOD tomorrow to meet Prism's board timeline.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Sr. Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: pricing_summary_prismhealth.xlsx, security_addendum_prism.pdf

Date: 2026-12-05T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Custom onboarding + premium support for PrismHealth — SOW and pricing

Agree we need quick exec input. Sales context: PrismHealth is strategic — if we lock them now, we stand to win several downstream clinical accounts. At the current list price the gross margin is thin after the requested work.

Recommendation: escalate to Marissa (VP Sales) and Finance for a one-time compromise: 25% discount + 3 months of SRE hours included, additional SRE billed at list or converted to committed hours in year 2. If execs push back, ask for revenue milestones tied to additional credits (M+3 and M+6).

Marissa — can you please provide direction on the discount band and whether we can approve up to 28% without CFO sign-off? If not, I'll route to Finance (jonas_weber) for a quick review.

-Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-05T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Custom onboarding + premium support for PrismHealth — SOW and pricing

Thanks for the clear summary. I don't want us to lose PrismHealth given the strategic fit, but we should protect margin where possible.

I'm willing to conditionally approve up to a 28% one-time concession and 3 months of dedicated SRE hours included in Y1, provided Finance (Jonas) signs off on the net present value impact and Legal signs the security addendum for retention exceptions. Anything beyond a 28% concession or longer SRE commitment requires CEO/CRO approval.

Mina — please prepare a one-pager that outlines: the ask, the NPV impact, alternate concession structures (25% + milestones; 28% conditional), and the proposed timeline for pilot and GA. Attach the one-pager in DocuSign-ready form so we can route it quickly. I have looped in Jonas for finance review.

Marissa
VP, Sales
Redwood Inference
